rows.reference: Haƙiƙa an ciro dukkan tsaye-tsaye don jerin ƙarshe, amma duk da kyawu da girman yadda yake, akwai dan talabijin na yara game da gaba ɗaya abin.

rows.source: Pretty moderate stuff.
rows.output: Abun da ya dace.
rows.reference: Matsakaicin kyakkyawan tsari.

rows.source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
rows.output: Kuma kamar da sauran finafinan Johnny English da na yi tunanin: shin masana'antar fim ta Birtaniya za su iya ba Rowan Atkinson wani aiki da ya dace da basirarsa?
rows.reference: Kuma da sauran fina-finan Johnny English ba zan iya daina tunani ba: shin me zai hana masana'antar fim ta Birtaniyya ta ba wa Rowan Atkinson wata rawa da zai taka wanda a zahiri za yi adalci ga hikimarsa?

rows.source: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days
rows.output: Labour ta musanta cewa tana shirya tsarin da zai sa 'yan ƙasar Birtaniya su yi aiki cikin kwanaki huɗu amma a biya su don kwanaki biyar
rows.reference: Labour ta ki yarda tana shirya wani shiri ne ga 'yan Birtaniyya su yi aiki na makon kwana huɗu amma a biya su kwanaki biyar

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar Labour ta Jeremy Corbyn za ta yi la'akari da wani shiri mai tsauri wanda zai ga 'yan Birtaniya suna aiki kwanaki huɗu a mako - amma suna samun biyan su don kwanaki biyar.
rows.reference: Jam'iyyar Labour ta Jeremy Corbyn za ta duba wani babban shirin wanda zai ga 'yan Birtaniyya suna yin aiki na kwana huɗu a mako - amma su sami biya na kwana biyar.

rows.source: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar tana son masu kamfanin su yi wa ma'aikata rangwame ta hanyar samar da ma'aikata ranar hutu ta bonus.
rows.reference: A cewar rahoto jam'iyyar tana son shugabannin kamfani su mika kuɗaɗen da aka adana ta cikin juyin juya halin hikimar da ba ta asali ba (AI) ga ma'aikata ta ba su ƙarin hutu kwana guda.

rows.source: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.
rows.output: Zai ga ma'aikata suna jin daɗin hutu na kwanaki uku - amma har yanzu suna samun kuɗin da suke samu.
rows.reference: Zai ga ma'aikata suna more wani ƙarshen na kwana uku - amma har yanzu su sami irin kuɗin da ake biyansu.

rows.source: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.
rows.output: An ruwaito cewa ra'ayin zai "dace" da tsarin tattalin arzikin jam'iyyar da kuma shirin saarar da kasar a kan ma'aikata.
rows.reference: Kafofin sun ce hikimar za ta 'dace' tare da ajandar tattalin arziki ta jam'iyyar da shirye-shirye da za su juya ƙasar zuwa abin da ma'aikata ke so.

rows.source: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.
rows.output: Matsawa zuwa satin aiki na kwanaki huɗu ya samu goyon bayan kungiyar Kwadago taya a matsayin hanyar da ma'aikata za su yi amfani da sauyin tattalin arziki.
rows.reference: Matsaya zuwa wani kwana huɗu na mako ya sami yardar Majalisar Ƙungiyar 'Yan Ƙwadago a matsayin wata hanya don ma'aikata su sami fa'ida ta canza tattalin arzikin.

rows.source: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.
rows.output: Wani babban mai ba da shawara a jam'iyyar Labour ya gaya wa The Sunday Times: "Ana sa ran a sanar da bitar manufofi kafin karshen shekarar.
rows.reference: Wata babbar kafa ta Jam'iyyar Labour ta faɗa wa The Sunday Times: Ana tsammanin sake duba ƙudurin da za a sanar kafin ƙarshen shekarar.

rows.source: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'
rows.output: 'Bai kamata ya faru ba cikin dare amma satin aiki na kwanaki huɗu shine abin da ya dace da hanyar jam'iyyar wajen daidaita tattalin arziki a madadin ma'aikata da kuma dabarar jam'iyyar gaba ɗaya ta masana'antu.'
rows.reference: Ba zai faru rana ɗaya ba amma wani makon aiki na kwana hudu abin jan hankali ne da ya dace a cikin hanyar jam'iyyar ga sake daidaita tattalin arziki don ma'aikacin har ma da gaba ɗaya dabarar jam'iyyar ta fuska masana'anta.'

rows.source: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar Kwadago ba ta zama jam'iyyar farko da za ta goyi bayan wannan ra'ayin ba, inda jam'iyyar Green ta yi alkawari da aikin mako huɗu a lokacin yakin zaben ta na shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Jam'iyyar Labour ba za ta zama ta farko da za ta yarda da irin ra'ayin ba, tare da Jam'iyyar Green da alkawarin makon aiki na kwana huɗu a lokacin kamfe ɗinta na zaɓen gama-gari a 2017.

rows.source: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.
rows.output: A halin yanzu ba a amince da neman mafaka daga jam'iyyar Labour ba gaba ɗaya.
rows.reference: A yanzu Jam'iyyar Labour ba ta nuna amincewa da jan hankali gaba ɗaya, amma.

rows.source: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'
rows.output: Wani jami'in jam'iyyar Labour ya ce: 'Mako hudu na aiki ba manufofin jam'iyyar ba ne kuma ba a duba ba.'
rows.reference: Wani mai magana da yawun Jam'iyyar Labour ya ce: Wani mako na aiki na kwana huɗu ba ƙudurin jam'iyya ne kuma jam'iyyar ma ta la'akari da shi.'

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
rows.output: Shin Chancellor John McDonnell ya yi amfani da taron jam'iyyar Labour na makwanni biyu da suka gabata don bayyana hangensa na juyin juya hali na zamantakewa.
rows.reference: Ƙaramin cansala John McDonnell ya yi amfani da taron Labour na makon da ya wuce don nuna abin da yake hange don wani juyin juya hali na aƙidar gurguzu a cikin tattalin arzikin.

rows.source: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.
rows.output: Mr McDonnell ya ce ya ke da niyyar dawo da iko daga 'masoyan da ba a gani ba' da 'masu riba' a kamfanonin samar da wutar lantarki.
rows.reference: Mista McDonnell ya ce yana shirye da ya kame iko daga 'daraktocin boye' da 'maciya riba' a kamfanonin amfanin jama'a.

rows.source: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.
rows.output: Shirye-shiryen shugaban jam'iyyar Labour sun kuma nuna cewa masu hannun jari na kamfanonin ruwa na yanzu ba za su samu dawowar hannun jarinsu gaba ɗaya ba, saboda gwamnatin Labour za ta iya yin 'ragi' bisa zargin rashin adalci.
rows.reference: Shiryen-shiryen ƙaramin cansalan kuma suna nufi masu zuba jari yanzu a cikin kamfanonin ruwa ba za su kila sami dawo da abin da suka sa gaba ɗaya ba saboda wata gwamnatin Labour za ta iya yin 'rage-rage' a bisa dalilai na abin da ake ganin bai dace ba.

rows.source: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
rows.output: Ya kuma tabbatar da shirin sanya ma'aikata a kan majalisun kamfanoni da kuma ƙirƙirar Asusun Mallakar Haɗaka don ba wa ma'aikata kashi 10 cikin 100 na hannun jarin kamfanoni masu zaman kansu, wanda za su iya samun riba na shekara-shekara har zuwa £500.
rows.reference: Ya kuma tabbatar da shirye-shiryen don sa ma'aikata a cikin hukumar kamfani da ƙirƙirar Asusunan Mallaka Ba Kowa don ba da kashi 10 cikin ɗari na daidaito kamfanonin ɓangaren 'yan kasuwa zuwa ga ma'aikata, waɗanda za su iya samun ribobi na shekara har kusan zuwa Euro 500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sun gaya wa "60 Minutes" cewa ko bincike na FBI kan Kavanaugh zai canza ra'ayoyinsu
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sun faɗa wa "60 Minutes" ko binciken FBI na Kavanaugh zai iya canza zuciyarsu.

rows.source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
rows.output: Binciken FBI kan zarge-zargen da ake yi wa Alkalin Brett Kavanaugh ya jinkirta kuri'ar da za ta yi na zaɓarsa a Kotun Koli da aƙalla sati guda, kuma ya haifar da tambayar ko gano binciken na iya rinjayar duk wani Sanatan Jam'iyyar Republican da ya yanke shawarar janyewa daga goyon bayan sa.
rows.reference: Binciken na FBI na ƙage a kan Alƙali Brett Kavanaugh ya jinkirta kaɗa kuri'a ƙarshen a kan wanda ya zaɓa zuwa Kotun Koli da aƙalla mako ɗaya, kuma ya tayar da tambayoyi ko sakamakon binciken na hukumar zai ja kowaɗanne sanatocin  Republican zuwa cikin goyon bayan nasu.

rows.source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.output: A cikin hirar da za ta fito a ranar Lahadi, maiar da "60 Minutes" Scott Pelley ya tambayi 'yan Republican John Kennedy da Lindsey Graham ko 'yan sanda za su iya samun wani abu da zai sa su canza ra'ayinsu.
rows.reference: A cikin wata intabiyu da aka wasa Lahadi, mai kawo rahoto na "60 Minutes" Scott Pelley ya tambayi Sanatan Republican John Kennedy da Lindsey Graham ko FBI za ta iya tsamo wani abu da zai kai su canza zuciyoyinsu.

rows.source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
rows.output: Kennedy ya bayyana ya fi bude ido fiye da abokin aikinsa daga Kudancin Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy ya bayyana shi ba rufa-rufa fiye da abokin aikinsa daga Carolina ta Kudu.

rows.source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
rows.output: "Na yi nufin, tabbas," in ji Kennedy.
rows.reference: Ina nufin, ba shakka, inji Kennedy.

rows.source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.output: "Na ce, "Na ce, "Na yi magana da Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: "Na ce zan shiga cikin wurin jin bahasin, inji ni, na yi magana da Alƙali Kavanaugh.

rows.source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
rows.output: Na kira shi bayan wannan ya faru, wannan ikirari ya fito, ya ce, 'Ka yi hakan?'
rows.reference: Na kira shi bayan wannan ya faru, cewa kage ya bayyana, na ce, 'Ka aika abin?'

rows.source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
rows.output: Ya kasance mai ƙudurin, mai himma, ba mai shakka ba."
rows.reference: Ya kasance a tsinake, shirye, kuma ba girgiza."

rows.source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
rows.output: Kuri'ar Graham, duk da haka, tana bayyana a fili.
rows.reference: Zaben Graham, amma, ya bayyana an shirya za a yi.

rows.source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
rows.output: "Zuciyata ta yanke hukunci game da Brett Kavanaugh kuma zai ɗauki wata accusation mai ƙarfi," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Zuciyata ta shirya game da Brett Kavanaugh kuma zai ɗauki wata 'yar babbar tuhuma," inji shi.

rows.source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: "Dr. Ford, ban sani ba abin da ya faru, amma na san wannan: Brett ya musanta hakan da ƙarfi," Graham ya kara, yana magana ne game da Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.reference: "Dokta Ford, ban san abin da ya faru ba, amma na san wannan: Brett ya musanta abin sosai," Graham ya ƙara da cewa, yana dangantawa zuwa ga Christine Blasey Ford.

rows.source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
rows.output: "Kuma dukkan wanda ta sanya masa suna ba zai iya tabbatar da hakan ba.
rows.reference: "Kuma duk kowa da da ta fadi sunaye ta gagara tantance shi.

rows.source: It's 36 years old.
rows.output: Shekarunta 36.
rows.reference: Shekaru 36 ne.

rows.source: I don't see anything new changing."
rows.output: Ban ga wani abu sabon da zai canza ba."
rows.reference: Ban ga kowane abu sabo da ke canjawa."

rows.source: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?
rows.output: Mene ne bikin Global Citizen Festival kuma Ya Yi Wani abu don Rage Talauci?
rows.reference: Mene ne Bikin 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya kuma Shin Ya Yi Wani Abu na Rage Talauci?

rows.source: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.
rows.output: A wannan ƙarshen mako New York za ta karbi bakuncin bikin Global Citizen Festival, wani biki na kiɗa na shekara-shekara wanda ke da jerin taurarin da suka yi fice da kuma aikin da ya yi fice; kawar da talauci a duniya.
rows.reference: Wannan Asabar New York za ta yi bakwancin Bikin 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya, wani bikin taron waka na shekara wanda ke da wani babban tasiri da zai jero taurari da za su yi wani mishan mai ban sha'awa shi ma; na kawo ƙarshen talauci.

rows.source: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.
rows.output: Yanzu a cikin shekarar ta bakwai, bikin Global Citizen Festival zai ga dubunnan mutane suna zuwa wajen shaƙatawa na babban filin a cikin birnin New York don jin dadiniririnirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinirinir
rows.reference: Yanzu yana cikin shekararsa ta bakwai, Bikin 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniyar zai ga dubun-dubatar ta mutane da za su yi tururuwa zuwa Great Lawn na Central Park ba kawai don more 'yan wasa kamar su Janet Jackson, Cardi B da Shawn Mendes ba, amma har da wayar da kai don gaskiyar manufar bikin na kawo ƙarshen matsanancin talauci zuwa 2030.

rows.source: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.
rows.output: Bukin Global Citizen, wanda ya fara a shekarar 2012, ci gaba ne na Global Poverty Project, wata kungiyar tallafi ta kasa da kasa da ke fatan kawar da talauci ta hanyar kara yawan mutanen da ke fafutukar kawar da shi.
rows.reference: Bikin na 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya, wanda aka fara a 2012, wani ci gaba ne da Aikin Duniya a kan Talauci, wani gungun ƙasa-da-ƙasa da ke fatan kawo ƙarshen talauci ta ara yawan mutane da ke yaƙi sosai a kansa.

rows.source: In order to receive a free ticket for the event (unless you were willing to pay for a VIP ticket), concertgoers had to complete a series of tasks, or "actions" such volunteering, emailing a world leader, making a phone call or any other meaningful ways to help raise awareness of their goal of ending poverty.
rows.output: Don samun tikiti kyauta don taron (sai dai idan kana son biyan kuɗin tikiti na musamman), masu halartar bikin sun yi wasu ayyuka, ko "ayyuka" kamar yin aikin sa kai, aika imel ga shugaban duniya, yin kira ko wasu hanyoyin da za su iya taimakawa wajen wayar da kan mutane game da manufar su ta kawar da talauci.
rows.reference: Don karɓan wani tikiti kyauta don hidimar (sai har kana son za ka biya wani tikitin manyan mutane), masu zuwa taron mawaƙa dole sai sun cika wani jere-jere na ayyukan da suka doru a kai, ko "ayyuka" irin sa-kai, aika imel zuwa wani shugaba na duniya, buga wani kiran waya ko kowaɗanne hanyoyi don taimakon wayar da kai na manufarsu ta kawo ƙarshen talauci.

rows.source: But just how successful has Global Citizen been with 12 years left to achieve its goal?
rows.output: Amma kawai ya yi nasara da yawa a cikin shekaru 12 da suka rage don cimma burinsa?
rows.reference: Amma yaya nasarar 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya ta kasance da shekaru 12 da suka saura na cimma manufarta?

rows.source: Is the idea of rewarding people with a free concert a genuine way to persuade people to demand a call for action, or just another case of so-called "clicktivism" - people feeling like they are making a true difference by signing an online petition or sending a tweet?
rows.output: Shin ra'ayin ba wa mutane kyauta naawa da gangami hanya ce ta gaskiya da za ta sa mutane su yi kira da a yi aiki, ko kawai waniari ne na "klicktivism" - mutane suna jin kamar suna yin wani abu na gaskiya ta hanyar sanya hannu a kan takardan neman zabe ko aika da saƙo a shafukan sada zumunta?
rows.reference: Shin hikimar saka wa mutane ta wata hanyar taron mawaka kyauta wata hanya ce mai kyau don jan hankalin mutane su nemi wani kira don a yi aiki, ko kawai wata hanya ce ta ra'ayin "clicktivism" - mutane suna jin kamar suna da gaske yin wani mai bambanci ta sa hannu a kan koke na yanar gizo ko aika wani sakon Twitter?

rows.source: Since 2011, Global Citizen says it has recorded more than 19 million "actions" from its supporters, pushing for a host of different goals.
rows.output: Tun daga 2011, Global Citizen ta ce ta rubuta fiye da ayyuka miliyan 19 daga masu goyon bayan ta, suna kira ga manufofi daban-daban.
rows.reference: Tun shekarar 2011, 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniyar ta ce ta tara rubutattun bayanai fiye da "ayyuka" miliyan 19 daga masu goyon bayanta, tana mai tura abubuwan da ke son cimmawa daban-daban.

rows.source: It says that these actions have helped spur world leaders to announce commitments and policies equating to more than $37 billion that is set to affect the lives of more than 2.25 billion people by 2030.
rows.output: Yana cewa waɗannan ayyukan sun taimaka wajen saukaka wa shugabannin duniya su sanar da alkawura da manufofi da suka kai fiye da dala biliyan 37 da za su yi tasiri a rayuwar mutane fiye da biliyan 2.25 nan da 2030.
rows.reference: Ya faɗa cewa waɗannan ayyukan sun taimaka wajen jan hankalin shugabannin duniya su sanar da alkawura da ƙudurori da suka kai kwatancin dala biliyan 37 da aka tsara za su shafi rayuwar fiye da mutane biliyan 2.25 a duniya zuwa shekara ta 2030.

rows.source: In early 2018, the group cited 390 commitments and announcements stemming from its actions, at least $10 billion of which have already been disbursed or fundraised.
rows.output: A farkon 2018, ƙungiyar ta ambaci 390 na sadaukarwa dauma daga cikin ayyukan su, aƙalla dala biliyan 10 na wanda aka riga aka rarraba ko kuma an tara.
rows.reference: A farkon 2018, gungun sun kawo alkawura da sanarwowi 390 da suka zo daga ayyukan nata, inda aƙalla an riga an kashe ko tara dala biliyan 10.

rows.source: The group estimates the secured funds have so far made a direct impact on nearly 649 million people across the world.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar ta kiyasta cewa kuɗin da aka kare ya yi tasiri kai tsaye a kan kusan mutane miliyan 649 a faɗin duniya.
rows.reference: Gungun yana kintacen kuɗaɗen da aka samu sun yi tasiri kai tsaye a kan kusan mutane miliyan 649 a faɗin duniyar.

rows.source: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a U.K. based partnership of investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential," promising to provide Rwanda with $35 million to help end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from Global Citizens.
rows.output: Wasu daga muhimman alkawuran sun haɗa da Ikon Abinci, wani haɗin gwiwa na masu saka hannun jari da masu aiwatar da ayyukan da ke cikin Birtaniya, da ke da niyyar "taimakawa yara su girma zuwa cikakken karfinsu," suna da niyyar samar da dalar Amurka miliyan 35 ga Rwanda don taimakawa wajen kawar da rashin abinci mai gina jiki a kasar bayan samun fiye da 4,700 tweets daga 'yan kasa da kasa.
rows.reference: Wasu daga muhimman sadaukarwar sun haɗa da Ƙarfin Abinci Mai Gina Jiki, wani gungun haɗin gwiwa na Ingila na masu zuba jari da masu aiwatar da suka himmatu don "taimakon yara su girma a cikin abin da za su iya yi cikekke," da alkawari samar wa Ruwanda da dala miliyan 35 don taimakon kawo ƙarshen rashin abinci mai gina jiki a cikin ƙasar bayan karɓan fiye da sakonnin Twitter 4,700 daga 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya.

rows.source: "With support from the UK government, donors, national governments, and Global Citizens just like you, we can make the social injustice of undernutrition a footnote in history," The Power of Nutrition ambassador Tracey Ullman told the crowd during a live concert in London in April 2018.
rows.output: Tare da goyon bayan gwamnatin Birtaniya, masu bayar da tallafi, gwamnatocin kasa, da 'yan kasa da kasa kamar ku, za mu iya juya rashin daidaito na rashin cin abinci mai gina jiki zuwa wani ɓangare na tarihi," mai wakiltar ikon samun abinci mai gina jiki Tracey Ullman ya faɗa wa taron a lokacin wani wasan kwaikwayo na kai tsaye a Landan a watan Afrilu 2018.
rows.reference: Tare da tallafi daga masu ba da tallafi na gwamnatin Ingila, masu ba da tallafi, gwamnatocin ƙasashe, da 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya kawai kamar ka, za mu iya maida rashin adalci na zamantakewa na ƙarancin abinci mai gina jiki wani abin tarihi, jakadiyar Ƙarfin Abinci Mai Gina Jiki Tracey Ullman ta faɗa a taron jama'a a lokacin wasan waka nan take a cikin Landan a cikin Afirilu 2018.

rows.source: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions were taken calling on the U.K. improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project, the Power of Nutrition, that will reach 5 million women and children with nutrition interventions.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar ta kuma ce bayan an ɗauki mataki fiye da 5,000 da suka yi kira ga gwamnatin Birtaniya da ta inganta abinci ga uwa da yara, gwamnatin ta sanar da tallafin wani aiki, karfin abinci, wanda zai kai mata da yara miliyan 5 da shawo kan matsalolin abinci.
rows.reference: Gungun mutanen kuma sun faɗa bayan ɗaukan ayyuka fiye da 5,000 da ke yin kira a kan Ingila ta inganta abinci mai gina jiki don iyaye mata da yara, gwamnatin ta sanar da kashe kuɗi don wani aiki, Karfin Abinci Mai Gina Jiki, wanda zai isa ga mata da yara miliyan 5 da tallafin kaya mai gina jiki.

rows.source: In response to one of the FAQs on its website asking "what makes you think we can end extreme poverty?"
rows.output: A matsayin martani ga FAQ a shafukan yanar gizo na tambayar "me yasa kake tunanin za mu iya kawar da talauci mai tsanani?"
rows.reference: A cikin martani ga daga cikin tambayoyin da aka faye yi a kan shafin yanar gizonta tana mai tambaya "me ke saka tunani za mu kawo karshen matsanancin talauci?"

rows.source: Global citizen replied: "It'll be a long and hard path - sometimes we will fall and fail.
rows.output: Ɗan ƙasa na duniya ya amsa: "Zai kasance hanya mai tsawo da wahala - wani lokacin za mu faɗi kuma mu gaza.
rows.reference: ‘Yan ƙasa na duniya sun yi martani: Zai zama wata hanya mai tsayi da wahala - wasu lokutan za mu fadi muka kasa.

rows.source: But, like the great civil rights and anti-apartheid movements before us, we will succeed, because we are more powerful together.
rows.output: Amma, kamar manyan motsin 'yancin ɗan adam da kuma yaƙi da wariyar launin fata da suka gabata, za mu yi nasara, saboda muna da ƙarfi sosai lokacin da muka haɗa kai.
rows.reference: Amma, kamar babbar gwagwarmayar neman 'yanci farar hula da gwagwarmayar adawa da mulkin wariyar launin fata da suka zo kafinmu, za mu ci nasara, saboda muna da ƙarfi sosai a tare.

rows.source: Janet Jackson, the Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe are among some of the acts performing at this year's event in New York, which will be hosted by Deborra-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.
rows.output: Janet Jackson, The Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe wasu daga cikin masu yin wasa a wannan bikin a New York, wanda Deborra-Lee Furness da Hugh Jackman za su jagoranta.
rows.reference: Janet Jackson, the Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe suna daga cikin 'yan wasa da za su yi wasa a wannan bikin shekara a cikin New York, wanda Deborra-Lee Furness da Hugh Jackman za su jagoranta.

rows.source: US could use Navy for "blockade" to hamper Russian energy exports - Interior Secretary
rows.output: Amurka za ta iya amfani da Sojojin Ruwa don "toshe" don tsoratar da fitar da makamashin Rasha - Sakatare na Cikin Gida
rows.reference: Amurka za ta yi amfani da sojojin ruwa don "toshewa" don hana fita da kayan Rasa - Sakataren Cikin Gida

rows.source: Washington can "if necessary" resort to its Navy to prevent Russian energy hitting the markets, including in the Middle East, US Internal Secretary Ryan Zinke has revealed, as cited by Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Washington na iya "idan ya zama tilas" yin amfani da sojojin ruwan sa don hana man fetur na Rasha isa kasuwanni, ciki har da a Gabas ta Tsakiya, kamar yaddaakin da Washington Examiner ya bayyana.
rows.reference: Washington za ta iya "idan ya zama wajibi" ta yi amfani da sojojin ruwanta don hana makamashin Rasha ya shiga kasuwannin, da suka hada da cikin Gabas ta Tsakiya, a cewar Sakataren Harkokin Cikin Gida na Amurka Ryan Zinke, kamar yadda Washington Examiner ta faɗa.

rows.source: Zinke alleged that Russia's engagement in Syria - notably, where it is operating at the invitation of the legitimate government - is a pretext to explore new energy markets.
rows.output: Zinke ya yi iƙirarin cewa shiga Rasha a Siriya - musamman, inda take aiki da izinin gwamnatin da ta dace - wani uzuri ne na bincika sababbin kasuwanni na makamashi.
rows.reference: Zinke ya yi ƙage cewa shigar Rasha cikin Siriya - wato, inda aka ce tana aiki ne saboda gayyatar da gwamnatin da aka sani ta yi mata - wani shaci-faɗi ne na neman gano sababbin kasuwannin makamashi.

rows.source: "I believe the reason they are in the Middle East is they want to broker energy just like they do in eastern Europe, the southern belly of Europe," he has reportedly said.
rows.output: "Na yarda da cewa dalilin da yasa suke a Gabas ta Tsakiya shi ne suna son su yi sulhu a kan makamashi kamar yadda suke yi a Gabas ta Turai, yankin kudu na Turai," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Na yi imani dalilin da ya sa suke cikin Gabas ta Tsakiya shi ne suna son su sami makamashi ne kamar yadda kawai suka yi a gabashin Turai, kudancin ciki na Turai," kamar yadda rahoto ya ce ya faɗa.

rows.source: And, according to to the official, there are ways and means to tackle it.
rows.output: Kuma, bisa ga hukumar, akwai hanyoyin da za a magance hakan.
rows.reference: Kuma, bisa ga jami'in, akwai hanyoyi da dabarun magance shi.

rows.source: "The United States has that ability, with our Navy, to make sure the sea lanes are open, and, if necessary, to blockade, to make sure that their energy does not go to market," he said.
rows.output: "Amurka na da wannan damar, tare da jiragen ruwa namu, don tabbatar da cewa hanyoyin teku suna bude, kuma, idan ya zama tilas, don kulle su, don tabbatar da cewa makamashinsu ba ya zuwa kasuwa," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Ƙasar Amurka na da ikon, tare da sojin ruwanmu, don tabbatar da hanyoyi teku na buɗe, kuma, idan ya kama, a tushe shi, don tabbatar da cewa makamashi su bai je kasuwa ba," in ji shi.

rows.source: Zinke was addressing the attendees of the event hosted by the Consumer Energy Alliance, a non-profit group which styles itself as the "voice of the energy consumer" in the US.
rows.output: Zinke yana magana ne ga mahalarta taron da kungiyar Consumer Energy Alliance ta shirya, wata kungiyar ba da shawara ba da aka fi sani da "muryan mai amfani da makamashi" a Amurka.
rows.reference: Zinke yana jawabi ga masu halartar taron da kamfanin Gamaiyyar masu Amfani da wutar Lantarki ta shirya, wani rukuni wanda bana riba ba ne wanda yayi kama da "muryar masu amfani da makamashi" a Amurka.

rows.source: He went to compare Washington's approaches to dealing with Russia and Iran, noting that they are effectively the same.
rows.output: Ya tafi ya kwatanta hanyoyin Washington na magance Rasha da Iran, yana lura cewa suna da tasiri iri ɗaya.
rows.reference: Yayi kwatance da hanyoyin da Washington ta bi wajen huldan Rasha da Iran, tun da yake sun kasance iri daya.

rows.source: "The economic option on Iran and Russia is, more or less, leveraging and replacing fuels," he said, while referring to Russia as a "one trick pony" with an economy dependent on fossil fuels.
rows.output: "Zaɓin tattalin arziki kan Iran da Rasha, kusan ba tare da la'akari ba, ya haɗa da maye gurbin man fetur," in ji shi, yayin da yake magana kan Rasha a matsayin "doki mai ban dariya" wanda tattalin arzikin sa ya dogara ne kan man fetur.
rows.reference: "Yankin tattalin arziki a kan Iran da Rasha shi ne, mafi yawa ko kasa, amfanuwa da maye gurbin man fetur," in ji shi, yayin da yake magana da Rasha a matsayin "tarin tsabar gari" tare da tattalin arziki da ke dogara da ƙafafun burbushin mai.

rows.source: The statements come as Trump administration has been on a mission to boost the export of its liquefied natural gas to Europe, replacing Russia, the far cheaper option for European consumers.
rows.output: Sanarwar ta zo ne a lokacin da gwamnatin Trump ta yi ta ƙoƙarin kara fitar da iskar gas da aka narkar zuwa Turai, don maye gurbin Rasha, wanda ya fi arha ga masu sayen Turai.
rows.reference: Maganganun sun zo ne a lokacin da gwamnatin Trump tun da ta fara aiki a kan manufa don inganta fitar da iskar gas ta mai ruwa zuwa Turai, ta maye gurbin Rasha, mafi arhan zabi ga masu amfani da shi a Turai.

rows.source: For that effect, the Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, try to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which according to Trump, made Berlin Moscow's "captive."
rows.output: Don wannan dalili, jami'an Trump, ciki har da shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da kansa, suna kokarin su shawo kan Jamus da ta fito daga cikin "ba daidai ba" na aikin bututun Nord Stream 2, wanda Trump ya ce ya sa Berlin ta zama "captive" na Moscow.
rows.reference: A sakamakon haka, jami'an gwamnatin Trump, ciki har da shugaban Kasar Amurka Donald Trump kansa, yayi ƙoƙarin rinjayar Jamus ta janye "wanda ba daidai ba ne" bututun man Nord Stream 2, wanda a cewar Trump, ya sanya Berlin Moscow’s ta zama “fursuna”.

rows.source: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity to 110 billion cubic meters, is a purely economic project.
rows.output: Moscow ta yi ta jaddada cewa bututun Nord Stream 2 mai tsada dalar Amurka biliyan 11, wanda aka shirya kara karfin bututun da ke wanzuwa zuwa biliyan cubic 110, aikin kasuwanci ne kawai.
rows.reference: Moscow ta kara jaddada cewa, Dala biliyan 11 na bututun man Nord Stream 2, wanda aka saita don ninka bututun mai me tasowa a yanzu har zuwa cubic mita biliyan 110, shi ne aikin tattalin arziki ne na gaskiya.

rows.source: The Kremlin argues that Washington's fervent opposition to the project is simply driven by economic reasons and is an example of unfair competition.
rows.output: Kremlin ya ce Washington ta yi adawa da aikin ne saboda dalilai na tattalin arziki, kuma hakan misali ne na gasa mara kyau.
rows.reference: Kremlin ya yi ikirarin cewa babbar hamayya Washington da wannan aikin ta kaddamar da shi ne ta hanyar tattalin arziki kuma ya zama misali na wasan da ba daidai ba.

rows.source: "I believe we share the view that energy cannot be a tool to exercise pressure and that consumers should be able to choose the suppliers," Russian Energy Minister Aleksandr Novak said following a meeting with US Energy Secretary Rick Perry in Moscow in September.
rows.output: "Na yarda da cewa muna da ra'ayi guda kan cewa makamashi ba za a iya amfani da shi wajen yin amfani da matsin lamba ba, kuma masu amfani da wutar lantarki ya kamata su sami damar zaɓar masu samar da wutar lantarki," in ji Ministan Makamashinya na Rasha Aleksandr Novak bayan wani taro da ya yi da Sakatare-Janar na Ma'aikatar Makamashinya ta Amurka Rick Perry a Moscow a watan Satumba.
rows.reference: "Ina ganin mu na da ra'ayi cewa makamashi ba zai zama kayan aikin matsa lamba daya dace ace masu amfani dashi sun zabi masu samar dashi," in ji ministan makamashi na Rasha Aleksandr Novak bayan ganawa da Sakataren Harkokin Makamashin Amurka Rick Perry a Moscow a watan Satumba.

rows.source: The US stance has drawn backlash from Germany, which has reaffirmed its commitment to the project.
rows.output: Martanin Amurka ya jawo ce-ce-ku-ce daga Jamus, wadda ta sake tabbatar da kudurinta na aikin.
rows.reference: Matakin Amurka ya jawo martani daga Jamus, wanda ya tabbatar da ƙaddamar da aikin.

rows.source: Germany's leading organization for industry, the Federation of German Industries (BDI), has called on the US to stay away from the EU energy policy and the bilateral agreements between Berlin and Moscow.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar jagoranci a masana'antu ta Jamus, Ƙungiyar Masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI), ta yi kira ga Amurka da ta tsaya a wajen manufofin makamashin EU da kuma yarjejeniyar da ke tsakanin Berlin da Moscow.
rows.reference: Ƙungiyar Jamus ta babbar masana'antu, kungiyar tarayyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI) ta yi kira ga Amurka da ta dakatar da manufofin makamashin EU da kuma yarjejeniyar hadin gwiwar tsakanin Berlin da Moscow.

rows.source: "I have a big problem when a third state interferes in our energy supply," Dieter Kempf, head of the Federation of German Industries (BDI) said following a recent meeting between German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
rows.output: "Ina da babban matsalar da ta shafi lokacin da wani jiha ta uku ta shiga cikin samar da wutar lantarki namu," Dieter Kempf, shugaban kungiyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI) ya ce bayan wani taro na kwanan nan tsakanin firaministan Jamus Angela Merkel da shugaban Rasha Vladimir Putin.
rows.reference: "Ina da babban matsala a yayin da jiha ta uku ta tsoma baki a wutar lantarkinmu," in ji Dieter Kempf, shugaban kungiyar tarayyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI), bayan yin wata ganawar da ta gabata tsakanin shugaban Jamus Angela Merkel da shugaban Rasha Vladimir Putin.

rows.source: Elizabeth Warren Will Take "Hard Look" At Running For President in 2020, Massachusetts Senator Says
rows.output: Elizabeth Warren za ta ɗauki "Hard Look" game da takarar President a 2020, Sanatan Massachusetts ta ce
rows.reference: Elizabeth Warren za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari" ga Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa a 2020, Sanata Massachusetts ta ce

rows.source: Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Saturday she would take a "hard look" at running for president following the midterm elections.
rows.output: Sanatan Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren ta ce a ranar Asabar za ta duba "da kyau" game da takarar president bayan zaben tsakiya.
rows.reference: Sanatar Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren ta ce a ranar Asabar za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari’’ akan tsayawar ta takarar Shugaban kasa bayan gudanar zaben tsaka-tsaki.

rows.source: During a town hall in Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren confirmed she'd consider running.
rows.output: A lokacin taron jama'a a Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren ya tabbatar cewa zai yi la'akari da takarar.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake majalisar gari a Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren Ta tabbatar da cewa za ta yi takara.

rows.source: "It's time for women to go to Washington and fix our broken government and that includes a woman at the top," she said, according to The Hill.
rows.output: "Ya yi da za mata su tafi Washington su gyara gwamnatin da ta lalace kuma hakan ya haɗa da mace a kan gaba," ta ce, a cewar The Hill.
rows.reference: "Lokaci ya yi da mata za su je Washington domin gyara karyayyiyar gwamnatinmu kuma wannan ya hada da matan dake sama," in ji ta, a cewar The Hill.

rows.source: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."
rows.output: "Bayan ranar 6 ga Nuwamba, zan duba sosai game da neman takarar shugan ƙasa."
rows.reference: “Bayan Nuwamba 6, Zan yi duba da kyau akan tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa .”

rows.source: Warren weighed in on President Donald Trump during the town hall, saying he was "taking this county in the wrong direction.
rows.output: Warren ya yi magana a kan shugaban kasa Donald Trump a lokacin taron, yana cewa yana "janyowa wannan gundumar a hanya mara kyau.
rows.reference: Warren ta yi tuhuma akan Shugaban Kasa Donald Trump a majalisar garin, yana cewa “yana mulkin kasar ta hanyar da bata dace ba.

rows.source: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.
rows.output: "Na damu sosai game da abin da Donald Trump ke yi wa dimokraɗiyya," ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ina matukar damuwa akan abun da Donald Trump yake ma dimokuradiyyarmu,” ta ce.

rows.source: Warren has been outspoken in her criticism of Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Warren ta kasance mai bayyana ra'ayinta game da Trump da kuma wanda ya yi takarar Kotun Koli, Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Warren ta dade tana sukar Trump da Wakilin sa na Babban Kotu Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: In a tweet on Friday, Warren said "of course we need an FBI investigation before voting."
rows.output: A wani tweet a ranar Juma'a, Warren ya ce "tabbas muna buƙatar bincike na FBI kafin zaben."
rows.reference: A wani tween ranar Juma’a, Warren ta ce, “hakika mu na bukatan bincinken FBI kafin zabe.”

rows.source: A poll released on Thursday, however, showed a majority of Warren's own constituents do not think she should run in 2020.
rows.output: Wani bincike da aka fitar a ranar Alhamis, duk da haka, ya nuna cewa mafi yawan mutanen da ke zaune a gundumar Warren ba sa ganin ya kamata ta yi takarar a shekarar 2020.
rows.reference: Wani sakamakon zabe da aka saki ranar Alhamis, duk da haka, ya nuna yawancin ‘yan yankin Warren basa tunanin tayi takara a 2020.

rows.source: Fifty-eight percent of "likely" Massachusetts voters said the senator should not run, according to the Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe poll.
rows.output: Kashi casa'in da takwas cikin dari na masu jefa kuri'a a Massachusetts sun ce dan takarar ya kamata ya yi watsi da takarar, a cewar binciken Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe.
rows.reference: Kashi hamsin da takwas na “yiyuwar” mazaban Massachusetts sun ce ‘yar majalisar kar tayi takara, bisa ga zaben Cibiyar Binciken Siyasa ta Jimi’ar Suffolk/Zaben Duniya na Boston.

rows.source: Thirty-two percent supported such a run.
rows.output: Kashi talatin da biyu na masu goyon bayan irin wannan gudu.
rows.reference: Kashi talatin da biyu sun ba da goyon bayan wannan takaran.

rows.source: The poll showed more support for a run by former Governor Deval Patrick, with 38 percent supporting a potential run and 48 percent against it.
rows.output: Binciken ya nuna cewa akwai ƙarin goyon baya ga takarar Deval Patrick, tsohon gwamnan, inda kashi 38 cikin 100 na masu zaɓe suka goyi bayanata da kuma kashi 48 cikin 100 da suka ki amincewa da shi.
rows.reference: Sakamakon zaben ya nuna mafi goyon bayan takarar tsohon gwamna Deval Patrick, wanda kashi 38 su na nuna goyon bayan yiyuwar takarar da kuma kashi 48 marasa goyon baya shi.

rows.source: Other high profile Democratic names discussed in regard to a potential 2020 run include former Vice President Joe Biden and Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.
rows.output: Sauran manyan sunayen jam'iyyar Democrat da aka tattauna a kan yiwuwar takarar 2020 sun hada da tsohon mataimakin shugaban kasa Joe Biden da kuma Sanata Bernie Sanders na Vermont.
rows.reference: Wasu manyan ‘yan Kungiyar Dimokuradiyya da aka tattauna akan yiyuwar takara a 2020 har da tsohon Mataimakin Shugaban Kasa Joe Biden da Dan Majalisar Vermont Bernie Sanders.

rows.source: Biden said he would decide officially by January, the Associated Press reported.
rows.output: Biden ya ce zai yanke hukunci a hukumance a watan Janairun, a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: Biden ya ce zai yanke shawara zuwa January, Associated Press ta kawo rihoto.

rows.source: Sarah Palin cites Track Palin's PTSD at Donald Trump rally
rows.output: Sarah Palin ta ambaci Track Palin's PTSD a taron Donald Trump
rows.reference: Sarah Palin Ta kaddamar da PTSD din Track Palin a taron Donald Trump

rows.source: Track Palin, 26, spent a year in Iraq after enlisting on Sept.
rows.output: Track Palin, 26, ya shafe shekara guda a Iraki bayan ya shiga a watan Satumba.
rows.reference: Track Palin, 26, ta yi shekara daya a Iraki bayan ta shiga soja a Satumba.

rows.source: He was arrested and charged in a domestic violence incident on Monday night
rows.output: An kama shi kuma an tuhume shi da laifin cin zarafin gida a daren Litinin
rows.reference: An ɗaure shi kuma an caje shi da tashin hankalin gida a daren Litinin

rows.source: "What my own son is going through, what he is going through coming back, I can relate to other families who feel ramifications of PTSD and some of the woundedness that our soldiers do return with," she told the audience at a rally for Donald Trump in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.output: "Abin da ɗana ke fuskanta, abin da yake fuskanta a lokacin da ya dawo, na iya fahimta da sauran iyalai waɗanda ke jin tasirin PTSD da wasu raunukan da sojojinmu ke dawowa da su," ta faɗa wa masu sauraro a wani gangami na Donald Trump a Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.reference: “Abin da ɗana yake ciki, abin da yake farfaɗowa daga, zan iya danganta da sauran iyalan da suke jin ƙaddamarwa game da PTSD da kuma wasu daga cikin raunin da sojoji suke dawo da su, ta faɗa wa mutanen dake taron Donald Trump a Tulsa, Oklahoma.

rows.source: Palin called his arrest "the elephant in the room" and said of her son and other war veterans, "they come back a bit different, they come back hardened, they come back wondering if there is that respect for what it is that their fellow soldiers and airmen, and every other member of the military, has given to the country."
rows.output: Palin ya kira kama shi "ƙaton giwa a cikin ɗakin" ya kuma ce game da ɗansa da sauransojin yaƙi, "sun dawo kadan daban, sun dawo da ƙarfi, sun dawo suna mamakin ko akwai girmamawa ga abin da sojojin su da sauran sojojin, da kowane memban soja, suka ba ƙasar."
rows.reference: Palin ta kira ɗaurin da aka masa “Giwa a cikin ɗaki” kuma ta ce akan ɗanta da wasu sojojin yaki, “su na dawowa a wani yanayi daban, su na da dawowa da rashin tausayi, su na dawowa a cikin tunanin idan akwai wannan girmamawan da yan’uwansu sojoji na kasa da na sama, da duk wani jam’in tsaro ya ba wa kasar sa.”

rows.source: He was arrested on Monday in Wasilla, Alaska, and charged with domestic violence assault on a female, interfering with a report of domestic violence and possession of a weapon while intoxicated, according to Dan Bennett, a spokesman for the Wasilla Police Department.
rows.output: An kama shi a ranar Litinin a Wasilla, Alaska, kuma an tuhume shi da cin zarafin gida, da tsangwama daarar cin zarafin gida, da kuma mallakar makami yayin da yake maye, a cewar Dan Bennett, mai magana da yawun rundunar 'yan sanda ta Wasilla.
rows.reference: An kama shi ne ranan Litinin a Wasilla, Alaska, kuma an caje shi da tashin hankalin cikin gida akan mace, tsoma kai a cikin rihoto akan tashin hankalin cikin gida da mallakar makami a yayin maye, a cewar Dan Bennet, Wakilin Sahen Yan Sanda na Wasilla.

rows.source: 18 states, D.C. support challenge to new asylum policy
rows.output: Jihohi 18, D.C. sun goyi bayan kalubale ga sabon manufofin neman mafaka
rows.reference: Jihohi 18, D.C. su na goyon bayan kalubalen sabon tsarin mafaka

rows.source: Eighteen states and the District of Columbia are supporting a legal challenge to a new U.S. policy that denies asylum to victims fleeing gang or domestic violence.
rows.output: Jihohi goma sha takwas da Gundumar Columbia suna goyon bayan ƙalubalen shari'a ga sabon tsarin Amurka da ke hana 'yan gudun hijira da ke guduwa daga tashin hankali ko tashin hankali.
rows.reference: Jihohi goma sha takwas da Gundumar Columbia su na goyon bayan kalubalen shari’a akan sabon tsarin Amurka da ke hanin mafaka ga tashin hankalin yan daba da tashin hankalin cikin gida.

rows.source: Representatives from the 18 states and the district filed a friend-of-the-court brief Friday in Washington to support an asylum-seeker challenging the policy, NBC News reported.
rows.output: Wakilan jihohin 18 da kuma yankin sun gabatar da wani brief na friend-of-the-court a ranar Juma'a a Washington don tallafa wa wanda ke neman mafaka wanda ke kalubalantar manufofin, a cewarararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararar
rows.reference: Wakilai daga kasashe 18 da gundumar sun yi fayil din bayanin abokin kotu ranar Juma’a, a Washington dan goyon bayan kalubalen mai neman mafaka akan tsarin, NBC ta kawo rihoto.

rows.source: The full name of the plaintiff in the Grace v. Sessions suit that the American Civil Liberties Union filed in August against the federal policy has not been revealed.
rows.output: Sunan mai karar a shari'ar Grace v. Sessions da kungiyar kare hakkin bil'adama ta Amurka ta gabatar a watan Agusta a kan manufofin tarayya ba a bayyana shi ba.
rows.reference: cikakken sunan Mai Kara a cikin Grace v. Ba’a warware karar taro da Kungiyar Yakin Basasa ta Amurka ta kai a Agusta akan tsarinn gwamnatin tarrayayar ba.

rows.source: She said her partner "and his violent gang member sons," abused her but U.S. officials denied her request for asylum July 20.
rows.output: Ta ce abokin tarayya "kuma 'yan kungiyar masu tayar da hankali," sun yi mata tsangwama, amma jami'an Amurka sun ki amincewa da bukatan neman mafaka a ranar 20 ga Yuli.
rows.reference: Ta ce abokiyar tarayyar ta “tare da rigimammun yaran shi yan daba,” sun zage ta amma jami’an Amurka sun hana bukatar mafakar ta Yuli 20.

rows.source: She was detained in Texas.
rows.output: An tsayar da ita a Texas.
rows.reference: An garkame ta a Texas.

rows.source: The states' attorneys supporting Grace described El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala, which produce a large number of applicants for U.S. asylum, as nations facing pervasive problems with gangs and domestic violence.
rows.output: Lauyoyin jihar da ke goyon bayan Grace sun bayyana Salvador, Honduras da Guatemala, wadanda ke samar da mafi yawan masu neman mafaka a Amurka, a matsayin kasashe da ke fuskantar matsalolin da suka shafi kungiyoyin masu tsattsauran ra'ayi da kuma tashin hankali a gida.
rows.reference: Lauyoyin jiha masu goyon bayan Grace sun kamanta El Salvador, Honduras da Guatemala, waɗanda ke samar da masu neman mafaka a Amurka da yawa, a matsayin jihohi masu fuskantar matsaloli masu yawa da yan daba da tashn hankalin cikin gida.

rows.source: The new U.S. asylum policy reversed a 2014 decision by the Board of Immigrant Appeals that allowed undocumented immigrants fleeing domestic violence to apply for asylum.
rows.output: Manufar sabon tsarin ba da mafaka na Amurka ta kawo sauyi ga wani hukunci da Majalisar Shige da Fice ta yi a shekarar 2014, wanda ya ba wa 'yan gudun hijira da ba su da takardun zama damar neman mafaka.
rows.reference: Sabon tsarin mafakan ya yi juyi da wani yanke shawarar 2014 ta Hukumar Izinin Shiga da Fice wanda ya ke barin masu gudun tashin hankalin cikin gida da ba su da takardu su nemi mafaka.

rows.source: District of Columbia Attorney General Karl Racine said in a statement Friday that the new policy "ignores decades of state, federal, and international law."
rows.output: Laƙabin Babban Lauyan Gundumar Columbia Karl Racine ya ce a cikin wani bayanin da aka fitar a ranar Juma'a cewa manufofin da aka sabunta "sun yi watsi da shekaru da dama na dokokin jihar, tarayya, da kasa."
rows.reference: Babban Lauyan Gundumar Columbia Karl Racine, ya ce a cikin wata sanarwar Juma'a cewa sabuwar manufar "ba ta kula da shekarun da suka gabata na jaha, tarayya, da shari’ar kasa da kasa."

rows.source: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be adjudicated on the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a bar violates that principle," the friend-of-the court brief said.
rows.output: Dokar tarayya tana buƙatar a yi la'akari da duk wata doka da ake yi wa 'yan gudun hijira, bisa ga takamaiman abubuwan da suka faru da kuma yanayin da suka shafi, kuma irin wannan dokar ta tauye wannan ka'ida, in ji wani mai goyon bayan karar.
rows.reference: “Shari’ar Tarayya na bukatar cewa duk wani ikirarin neman mafaka da za a yanke hukunci a kan ainihin lamarin da, kuma irin wannan igiya ya karya wannan ka'idar, "in ji abokin shawarar kotu.

rows.source: Attorneys further argued in the brief that the policy denying immigrants entry hurts the U.S. economy, saying they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and "supply necessary labor."
rows.output: An yi hujja a cikin guntun cewa dokar da ke hana 'yan gudun hijira shiga ƙasar na cutar da tattalin arzikin Amurka, inda aka ce suna da yiwuwar zama masu kasuwanci kuma "sun samar da aikin da ake buƙata."
rows.reference: Hukumomi sun ci gaba da jaddada bayyanan cewa manufofin hana ‘yan hijara shiga cutar da tattalin arzikin Amurka, su na cewa za su iya zama 'yan kasuwa da "samar da aikin da ya kamata."

rows.source: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges to no longer grant asylum to victims fleeing domestic abuse and gang violence in June.
rows.output: Babban Lauyan Amurka Jeff Sessions ya umarci alkalan shiga da ke kan harkan shiga da ke ba da izinin neman mafaka ga wadanda suka tsere daga cin zarafi a gida da kuma tashin hankali a watan Yuni.
rows.reference: Babban Lauya Jeff Sessions ya umarci mahukuntan bakin haure da kada su sake ba da mafaka ga waɗanda ke fama da mummunar tashin hankali a cikin gida da kuma rikicin daba a watan Yuni.

rows.source: "Asylum is available for those who leave their home country because of persecution or fear on account of race, religion, nationality, or membership in a particular social group or political opinion," Sessions said in his June 11 announcement of the policy.
rows.output: "An ba da mafaka ga waɗanda suka bar ƙasar su saboda tsoratarwa ko tsoro saboda launinsu, addini, ƙasa, ko kuma mambobin ƙungiyar zamantakewa ko ra'ayin siyasa," Sessions ya bayyana a cikin sanarwarsa na Yuni 11 na manufofin.
rows.reference: "Mafaka na samuwa ga waɗanda suka bar ƙasarsu saboda zalunci ko tsoro saboda kabilanci, addini, asali, ko wakilci a wata ƙungiya ko ra'ayin siyasa," Sessions ya ce a ranar 11 ga watan yuni na sanarwar manufofin.

rows.source: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.
rows.output: Maganin rashin lafiya ba ya nufin rage duk matsalolin da mutane ke fuskanta a kowace rana a faɗin duniya.
rows.reference: Bada mafaka ba zai warware dukkan matsalolin ba - ko dukan matsaloli masu tsanani - da mutane ke fuskantar kowace rana a duk faɗin duniya.

rows.source: Desperate rescue efforts in Palu as death toll doubles in race to find survivors
rows.output: Ƙoƙarin ceto da ke cikin Palu yayin da adadin wadanda suka mutu ya ninka a cikin tseren neman waɗanda suka tsira
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin gaggawa na ceto a Palu yayin da mutuwar mutane ke kara tsanantuwa a gudun ceto rayayyu

rows.source: For survivors, the situation was increasingly dire.
rows.output: Ga waɗanda suka tsira, halin ya ci gaba da tabarbarewa.
rows.reference: Ga rayayyun, halin da ake ciki ya kara daɗuwa.

rows.source: "It feels very tense," said 35-year-old mother Risa Kusuma, comforting her feverish baby boy at an evacuation centre in the gutted city of Palu.
rows.output: "Yana jin kamar yana da matuƙar damuwa," in ji matar mai shekaru 35, Risa Kusuma, tana ta'aziyyan jaririnta mai zazzaɓi a wani sansani na 'yan gudun hijira a birnin Palu da ya lalace.
rows.reference: "Yana na da tashin hankali," in ji uwargida mai shekaru 35, Risa Kusuma, tana ta'azantar da jaririnta a wani wuri da aka aje su a garin Palu.

rows.source: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: "Kowane mintuna da motar asibiti ke kawo gawarwaki.
rows.reference: “Cikin kowane minti motar asibiti ke shigo da gawawaki.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce."
rows.output: Ruwa mai tsafta ba ya da yawa."
rows.reference: Ga wahala tsabtataccen Ruwa.”

rows.source: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.
rows.output: An ga mazauna wurin suna komawa gidajensu da suka lalace, suna zugiwa cikin kayayyakin da suka lalace, suna ƙoƙarin ceto duk wani abu da za su iya samu.
rows.reference: An ga mazauna wurin su na dawowa gidaje su da ke a rushe, su na tsintar kayayyakin daga cikin ruwa, su na ƙoƙarin kimtsa duk abin da zasu iya samu.

rows.source: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.
rows.output: An ji wa mutane da dama rauni, kuma asibitoci, waɗanda aka lalata ta girgizar ƙasar mai girma 7.5, sun yi cunkoso.
rows.reference: Daruruwan mutane sun jikkata kuma asibitoci, sun lalace sakamakon girgizar kasa mai tsananin 7.5, ya mamaye.

rows.source: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.
rows.output: Wasu daga cikin waɗanda suka ji rauni, ciki har da Dwi Haris, wanda ya ji rauni a bayansa da kafa, suna hutawa a wajen asibitin sojojin Palu, inda ake yi wa marasa lafiya magani a waje saboda har yanzu ana samun girgizar ƙasa mai karfi.
rows.reference: Wasu daga cikin waɗanda suka jikkata, cikinsu har da Dwi Haris, wanda ya sami rauni a baya da kafada, yana hutawa a bayan asibitin Palu’s Army, inda ake kula da marasa lafiya a waje saboda karfin Jiamamin abun da ya faru.

rows.source: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.
rows.output: Idanunshi sun cika da hawaye yayin da yake ba da labarin jin girgizar ƙasar mai karfi da ta girgiza ɗakin otal ɗin da ke bene na biyar da ya yi da matarsa da 'yarsa.
rows.reference: Hawaye ya cika idanunsa yayin da yake tuna yanayin girgizar kasa ta girgiza har dakin otel hawa na biyar da yake da matarsa ​​da 'yar shi.

rows.source: "There was no time to save ourselves.
rows.output: "Ba wani lokaci da za mu yi wa kanmu kariya.
rows.reference: “Bamu da lokacin tseratar da kammu.

rows.source: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.
rows.output: An matse ni cikin ruina na bango, ina tunanin," Haris ya gaya wa Associated Press, yana ƙara cewa iyalinsa suna cikin garin don bikin auren.
rows.reference: An matse ni cikin rusasshen bango, ina tsammanin, "Haris ya shaidawa Gamammun yan Jarida, ya kara da cewa iyalinsa sun zo garin ne don bikin aure.

rows.source: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.
rows.output: "Na ji matar ta yi kuka don taimako, amma sai shuru.
rows.reference: “Na ji matata na kukan nema taimako, sai kuma shiru.

rows.source: I don't know what happened to her and my child.
rows.output: Ban san me ya faru da ita da jaririna ba.
rows.reference: Ban san mai ya faru da ita da ‘ya ta ba.

rows.source: I hope they are safe."
rows.output: Ina fatan suna cikin aminci."
rows.reference: Ina tsammanin dai su na lafiya.”

rows.source: U.S. ambassador accuses China of 'bullying' with 'propaganda ads'
rows.output: Jakadan Amurka ya zarge kasar Sin da "damfara" da "tallace-tallacen da ke damun"
rows.reference: Jakadan Amurka ya zargi kasar Sin da 'cin zarafi' tare da 'farfaganda talla'

rows.source: A week after an official Chinese newspaper ran a four-page ad in a U.S. daily touting the mutual benefits of U.S.-China trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the American press to spread propaganda.
rows.output: Mako guda bayan wani jarida na hukuma na kasar Sin ya buga wani talla na shafuka hudu a cikin wani jarida na Amurka, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin ya yi zargin cewa birnin Beijing na amfani da jaridu na Amurka wajen yada labarai.
rows.reference: A mako daya bayan wata jarida ta kasar Sin ta yi amfani da shafuka hudu a kowace rana tana tallar kushe alakar kasuwanci Amurka - Sin, duk da haka, jakadun Amurka na kasar Sin ya zargi Beijing da yin amfani da manema labaran Amurka da yada farfaganda.

rows.source: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday referred to the China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register - the state of Iowa's biggest selling newspaper - after accusing China of seeking to meddle in the Nov. 6 U.S. congressional elections, a charge China denies.
rows.output: Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya yi magana a kan wani sashe da China Daily ta biya a cikin The Des Moines Register, wanda shine mafi yawan jaridu a Iowa, bayan ya yi zargin cewa China na son tsoma baki a zaben Majalisar Dokoki ta Amurka a ranar 6 ga Nuwamba, wanda China ta musanta.
rows.reference: Amurka Shugaban kasar Donald Trump a ranar Laraba da ta gabata ya nuna cewa Sin na biyan kudi a kullum ga ragista Des Moines - Jarida mafi yawan sayarwa a Jihar Iowa - bayan da aka zarge kasar Sin da neman shiga harkokin a zaben shugaban kasa na watan Nuwamba 6, zargin da Sin ta karyata.

rows.source: Trump's accusation that Beijing was trying to meddle in U.S. elections marked what U.S. officials told Reuters was a new phase in an escalating campaign by Washington to put pressure on China.
rows.output: Zargin Trump cewa Beijing na ƙoƙarin tsangwama a zaben Amurka ya nuna wani sabon mataki a cikin yakin da ke ci gaba tsakanin Washington da Beijing.
rows.reference: Zargin Trump akan cewa Beijing tana kokarin neman shiga harkokin a zaben Amurka wanda ya nuna cewa jami'an Amurka sun shaida wa kamfanin dillancin labarun Reuters cewa, wani sabon shiri ne na Washington da Amurka ta matsa lamba kan kasar Sin.

rows.source: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.
rows.output: Yayin da ya zama ruwan dare ga gwamnatin waje ta sanya tallace-tallace don inganta kasuwanci, Beijing da Washington a halin yanzu suna cikin yakin kasuwanci da ya karu wanda ya sa suka sanya juna dokoki na sanya haraji a kan shigo da kaya.
rows.reference: Daidai ne ga gwamnatocin kasashen waje su gabatar da tallace-tallace don inganta cinikayya, Beijing da Washington su na kulle a cikin wani yunkurin cinikayyar yaki wanda ya kai su ga matakan jadawalin kudaden shiga akan kowane.

rows.source: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.
rows.output: An yi wa masu fitar da kaya na China na farko a cikin yakin cin zarafi don cutar da masu goyon bayan jam'iyyar Republican ta Trump a jihohi kamar Iowa, in ji masu ba da shawara na Sin da Amurka.
rows.reference: Martanin kasar Sin na farkon akan jadawalin kuɗin fito a yakin kasuwanci shi ne kaddamar da masana'antu da za su karya jihohi irin su Iowa wanda dake goyon bayan Jam'iyyar Republican Party na Trump, Sinanci da Amurka suka fada.

rows.source: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.
rows.output: Terry Branstad, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin kuma tsohon gwamnan Iowa, babban mai fitar da noma zuwa kasar Sin, ya ce Beijing ya cutar da ma'aikata, manoma da 'yan kasuwa na Amurka.
rows.reference: Terry Branstad, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin da kuma tsohon gwamnan jihar Iowa, babban mai sayar da kayan aikin noma zuwa kasar Sin, ya ce Beijing ta cutar da ma'aikatan Amurka, manoma da kasuwanni.

rows.source: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."
rows.output: Sin, Branstad ya rubuta a cikin wani ra'ayi a cikin Des Moines Register a ranar Lahadi, "yanzu tana ƙara yawan yin wannan matsi ta hanyar gudanar da tallace-tallace na talla a cikin jarida namu na 'yanci."
rows.reference: Sin, Branstad ya rubuta a wani sashi na ra'ayi a ranar Lahadi cikin Ragista Des Moines, "yanzu yana raguwar a kan wannan cin zarafi ta hanyar yin amfani da tallace-tallacen farfaganda a cikin jaridun kyauta."

rows.source: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.
rows.output: "A cikin yaɗa ra'ayoyinsa, gwamnatin Sin tana amfani da al'adar Amurka ta 'yancin magana da 'yancin jarida ta hanyar sanya talla a cikin Des Moines Register," Branstad ya rubuta.
rows.reference: "A cikin watsa labaran furofaganda, gwamnatin kasar Sin tana ba da gudummawa game da kirkirar al'adun Amurka na ‘yancin magana da ‘yancin yan jaridu ta hanyar biyan tallace-tallace a cikin Ragista Des Moines," in ji Branstad.

rows.source: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.
rows.output: "A maimakon haka, a wurin sayar da labarai a ƙasan titin nan a Beijing, za ka ga muryoyi masu adawa da ra'ayi kaɗan kuma ba za ka ga wani gaskiya na ra'ayoyi daban-daban da mutanen Sin za su iya da su kan hanyar tattalin arzikin Sin mai wahala, ganin cewa kafafen yada labarai suna ƙarƙashin cikakken iko na jam'iyyar Kwaminis ta Sin," ya rubuta.
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewar, "a gurin karatu a birnin Beijing, za ku samu ba hayaniyar muryoyi da zai iya hanaku fahimtar ra’ayoyi daban-daban da al'ummar kasar Sin ke fuskanta na damuwar tatalin arziki, saboda gidan watsa labarai na karkashin ikon Jam'iyyar Kwaminis ta Sin, "in ji shi.

rows.source: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.
rows.output: Ya kara da cewa "daya daga cikin jaridu mafi shahara a kasar Sin ya ki karɓar tayin buga"rubutun nasa, duk da cewa bai bayyana sunan jaridar ba.
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewa "daya daga cikin jaridu mafi shahara a kasar Sin ya yi watsi da tayin don buga" labarinsa, duk da dai bai fadi wace jarida ce ba.

rows.source: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn
rows.output: Masu ra'ayin jam'iyyar Republican suna fitar da masu jefa kuri'a mata a gaba da tsagerun da suka shafi Kavanaugh, a cewar masu nazarin al'amura.
rows.reference: 'Yan Republican Su na Rarraba Kan Mata Masu Zabe Gabanin Tsaka-Tsakin Mulki Tare da Kavanaugh Debacle, Masu sa ido sunyi gargadin

rows.source: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.
rows.output: Yayin da yawancin manyan jam'iyyar Republican ke tsaya tare da kare zaben Kotun Koli na Brett Kavanaugh a cikin zargin cin zarafi da yawa, masu nazarin al'amura sun yi gargadin cewa za su fuskanci ramuwar gayya, musamman daga mata, a lokacin zaben tsakiyar wa'adi.
rows.reference: Da yawa daga cikin manya Republican sun tsaya kyam kuma su na kare wakilin Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh yayin da yake fuskantar zargin cin zarafin mata, masu sa ido sun yi gargadin cewa za su ga cikas, musamman daga mata, a lokacin zaɓen a tsaka-tsaki mai zuwa.

rows.source: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.
rows.output: Yadda ake ji game da wannan ya yi matuƙar yawa, kuma yawancin 'yan jam'iyyar Republican sun riga sun nuna cewa sun so su ci gaba da zaben.
rows.reference: Halin da ke kewaye da wannan ya kasance mai girma, kuma yawancin 'yan Jamhuriyyar Republican su na cikin tsarin dake nuna cewa su na son ci gaba da zabe.

rows.source: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.
rows.output: Waɗannan abubuwan ba za a iya komawa baya ba," Grant Reeher, farfesa a ilimin siyasa a Jami'ar Syracuse's Maxwell School ya faɗa wa The Hill a wani labari da aka buga a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Waɗannan abubuwa ba za a iya komawa baya da su ba, "Grant Reeher, farfesa a kimiyyar siyasa a makarantar Maxwell School a Jami'ar Syracuse ya shaidawa The Hill na wani labarin da aka buga a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.
rows.output: Reeher ya ce bai yarda da Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) na ƙarshe na neman bincike na FBI ba zai isa ya kwantar da hankali ga masu jefa kuri'a.
rows.reference: Reeher ya ce yana shakkun Sanata Jeff Flake na (R-Arizona) a turawan karshe na binciken FBI zai iya tunzurawa zuwa ga fushin masu zabe.

rows.source: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.
rows.output: "Matan ba za su manta da abin da ya faru jiya ba - ba za su manta da shi gobe ba kuma ba a watan Nuwamba ba," Karine Jean-Pierre, mai ba da shawara ta musamman kuma mai magana da yawun kasa na kungiyar ci gaba ta MoveOn ta ce a ranar Juma'a, a cewar jaridar Washington, D.C.
rows.reference: "Mata ba za su manta da abin da ya faru a jiya ba - ba za su manta da gobe ba a watan Nuwamba," in ji Karine Jean-Pierre, babban jami'in shawara kuma kakakin mai magana da yawun mata 'yan kungiyar MatsaGaba tace a ranar Jumma'a, a cewar Jaridar Washington DC.

rows.source: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.
rows.output: A ranar Juma'a, masu zanga-zanga sun yi zanga-zanga "Nuwamba na zuwa!" yayin da suke nuna adawa a cikin falon Majalisar Dattijai yayin da jam'iyyar Republican da ke kula da kwamitin shari'a ta ci gaba da gabatar da zaben Kavanaugh duk da shaidun Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, a cewar Mic.
rows.reference: A safiyar Jumma'a, masu zanga-zangar sun yi waka "Nuwamba na zuwa!" kamar yadda suka nuna a zauren majalisar dattawa kamar yadda 'yan Republican waɗanda ke kula da kwamitin Shari'a sun zabi su cigaba da gabatarwar Kavanaugh duk da shaidar Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic ne ya kawo rohoton.

rows.source: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.
rows.output: "Ƙwarin guiwa da kuma ƙarfafa guiwar masu ra'ayin jam'iyyar dimokraɗiyya za su yi yawa," Stu Rothenberg, mai nazarin siyasa wanda ba ya jam'iyya, ya faɗa wa shafukan labarai.
rows.reference: "Sha'awar dimokuradiya da karfafa gwiwa zai fita a cikin sakon," in ji Stu Rothenberg, mai ba da rahotannin siyasa, ya fada shafin labaran yanar gizon.

rows.source: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.
rows.output: "Mutane suna cewa ya riga ya yi sama; haka ne gaskiya.
rows.reference: "Mutane su na cewa ya riga ya kasance a sama, wannan gaskiya ne.

rows.source: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."
rows.output: Amma zai iya zama mafi girma, musamman a tsakanin masu jefa kuri'a na mata masu juyawa a cikin unguwanni da masu jefa kuri'a matasa, masu shekaru 18 zuwa 29, waɗanda duk da cewa ba sa son shugaban kasa, sau da yawa ba sa jefa kuri'a."
rows.reference: Amma zai iya zama mafi girma, musamman a tsakanin kungiyoyin mata masu jefa kuri'a, a yankunan karkara da kananun masu jefa kuri'a, 'yan shekaru 18 zuwa 29, waɗanda ba su son shugaba, ba za su yi zabe ba."

rows.source: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.
rows.output: Koda yake kafin Ford ta yi shaida a bainar jama'a game da zarge-zargen cin zarafi da ta yi wa wanda aka zaba a kotun koli, masu nazarin al'amura sun ba da shawarar cewa za a iya samu martani idan jam'iyyar Republican ta ci gaba da tabbatar da zaben.
rows.reference: Ko kafin shaida Ford ta bayyana ga jama’a game da zarginta na cin zarafin jima'i akan Kotun Koli zababbe, masu sharhi sun nuna goyon bayan da za su iya biyo baya idan Jamhuriyyar Republican ta ci gaba da tabbatarwa.

rows.source: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.
rows.output: "Wannan ya zama wani rudani ga jam'iyyar Republican," in ji Michael Steele, tsohon shugaban kwamitin Republican National Committee, a farkon mako na baya, a cewar NBC News.
rows.reference: "Wannan ya zama babban rikici ga GOP," in ji Michael Steele, tsohon shugaban kwamitin Republican Kwamitin Tarayya, a farkon makon da ya gabata, a cewar Labaran NBC.

rows.source: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.
rows.output: "Ba kawai game da kuri'ar kwamitin ba ne ko kuma kuri'ar karshe ko kuma ko dai an sanya Kavanaugh a kan benci, ba ne kawai game da yadda jam'iyyar Republican ta yi da kuma yadda suka yi mata," Guy Cecil, darakta na Priorities USA, wata kungiyar da ke taimakawa jam'iyyar Democrat, ya bayyana ga tashar.
rows.reference: "Ba kawai game da zaben kwamitin ko zaben karshe ko kuma Kavanaugh aka sanya a kan benci, kuma game da yadda Republicans suka magance wannan da yadda suka yi mata," Guy Cecil, darektan Fifikon Amurka, wani rukuni na taimakawa don zabe 'yan Democrat, da aka nuna wa tashar watsa labarai.

rows.source: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.
rows.output: Duk da haka, da alamu Amurka ba su da ra'ayi ɗaya game da wanda ya fi yarda da shi bayan shaidun Ford da Kavanaugh, tare da kadan da suka fi goyon bayan na baya.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, Amirkawa sun rabu akan wanda zasu gaskanta bayan bayyyanar shaidar Ford da Kavanaugh, tare da rinjaye kadan da kuna rinjaye anjima.

rows.source: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Sabon bincike daga YouGov ya nuna cewa kashi 41 cikin 100 na wadanda suka amsa sun yarda da shaidar Ford, yayin da kashi 35 cikin 100 suka ce tabbas ko wataƙila sun yarda da Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Wani sabon zabe YouGov ya nuna kashi 41 cikin dari na masu amsa shakka ko tabbas sun gaskanta gaskiyar Ford, yayin da kashi 35 cikin dari sun tabbata ko tabbas sunyi imani da Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.
rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, kashi 38 cikin 100 na masu amsa sun ce sun yi imani cewa Kavanaugh ya yi ƙarya a lokacin da ya yi shaida, yayin da kashi 30 cikin 100 suka ce hakan game da Ford.
rows.reference: Bugu da ƙari, kashi 38 cikin dari sun ce sunyi tunanin Kavanaugh ya yi ƙarya a lokacin da yake gabatar da shaida, yayin da kawai kashi 30 cikin dari suka faɗi daidai da Ford.

rows.source: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.
rows.output: Bayan tura Flake, a halin yanzu FBI na bincike kan zargin da Ford ya kawo, da kuma aƙalla wani mai zargin, Deborah Ramirez, a cewar Guardian.
rows.reference: Bayan turi daga Flake, FBI na binciken lamarin da Ford suka gabatar da shi tare da wani mutum daya da ake zargi, Deborah Ramirez, a cewar The Guardian.

rows.source: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.
rows.output: Ford ta yi shaida a gaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattijai a makwanni da suka gabata cewa Kavanaugh ya yi mata cin zarafi cikin maye a lokacin da take da shekara 17.
rows.reference: Ford ya bayyana a gaban Majalisar kwamitin Dattijan Shari'a da rantsuwa a makon da ya wuce cewa Kavanaugh na maye lokacin da yaci zarafinta tana da shekaru 17.

rows.source: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.
rows.output: Ramirez ya yi iƙirarin cewa wanda aka zaba a matsayin alkalin kotun koli ya bayyana jinsinsa ga ita yayin da suke halartar wani biki a lokacin da suke karatun shari'a a Yale a cikin shekarun 1980.
rows.reference: Ramirez yayi zargin cewa zababben dan Kotun Kolin ya nuna al'aurarsa gare ta yayin da suke halarci wata ƙungiya a yayin da suke karatun Yale a shekarun 1980.

rows.source: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook
rows.output: Mai Kirkiran Intanet Ya Tsara Don Fara Sabon Intanet Don Gasa da Google da Facebook
rows.reference: Wanda ya kirkiro yanar gizo ta duniya yana shirin fara sabon yanar gizo akan farfajiyar google da facebook.

rows.source: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.
rows.output: Tim Berners-Lee, wanda ya kirƙiro yanar gizo, yana ƙaddamar wani kamfani da ke neman ya yi gasa da Facebook, Amazon da Google.
rows.reference: Tim Berners-Lee, wanda ya Ƙirƙiri Yanar Gizo a duniya, yana ƙaddamar fara wani shiri wanda zai yi gogayya da Facebook, Amazon da Google.

rows.source: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.
rows.output: An yi wa fasahar almarar da ta fi shahara a cikin aikin da ta fi shahara, Inrupt, wani kamfani ne da ke gina kan dandalin Solid na Berners-Lee mai budewa.
rows.reference: Kayan aikin fasaha na zamani Inrupt, wani kamfanin ne wanda ke gina cibiyar dandalin budewa na Berners-Lee Solid.

rows.source: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.
rows.output: Solid yana ba masu amfani damar zaɓar inda bayanan su za su kasance kuma wa ya samu damar samun damar zuwa bayanan.
rows.reference: Ma’adinai na ba masu amfani damar zabar wajen adana bayyanai da kuma abin da aka ba mutane damar samun damar bayanai.

rows.source: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."
rows.output: A cikin wani hira na musamman da Fast Company, Berners-Lee ya yi dariya cewa manufar da ke bayan Inrupt ita ce "mulkin duniya."
rows.reference: A wata ganawa ta musamman tare da kamfanin Fast, Berners-Lee ya raha cewa, dalilin kera Inrupt shi ne "mulkin duniya."

rows.source: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.
rows.output: "Ya kamata mu yi shi yanzu," ya ce game da kamfanin.
rows.reference: "Ba dole ne mu yi shi yanzu ba," ya ce game da farawa.

rows.source: "It's a historical moment."
rows.output: "Ƙarshen tarihi ne."
rows.reference: "Lokacin tarihi ne yanzu."

rows.source: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.
rows.output: Manhajar tana amfani da fasahar Solid don ba wa mutane damar ƙirƙirar nasu "kantin bayanai na kan layi" ko POD.
rows.reference: Aikace-aikace yana amfani da fasaha na Solid don bawa mutane damar ƙirƙirar nasu "bayanan ajiya a intanit" ko POD.

rows.source: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.
rows.output: Zai iya ɗauke da jerin tuntuɓe, jerin abubuwan da za a yi, kalandar, ɗakin kiɗa, da sauran kayan sirri da na sana'a.
rows.reference: Yakan ƙunshi jerin lambobin sadarwa, jerin abubuwan da za’a yi, kalandar, ɗakin karatu na wakoki da wasu kayan aiki na kai kadai da gwanayen kayan aiki.

rows.source: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.
rows.output: Kamar Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack da Spotify duk suna samuwa a kan mai bincike guda ɗaya kuma a lokaci guda.
rows.reference: Yana kama da Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack da Spotify duk su na samuwa a kan farfajiyar bincike daya duk a lokaci guda.

rows.source: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.
rows.output: Abin da ya bambanta game da ma'ajiyar bayanai ta yanar gizo na sirri shi ne cewa ya rage ga mai amfani da ya samu damar samun wani irin bayanai.
rows.reference: Abun ban mamaki game da gurbin ajiya na kai a shagon yanar gizo shi ne cewa mai amfani da shi na da cikakken ikon samun irin bayanai.

rows.source: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."
rows.output: Kungiyoyin sun kira shi "samo iko ta hanyar bayanai."
rows.reference: Kamfanin ya kira shi "karfafawa ta hanyar bayanan da aka tattara ."

rows.source: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.
rows.output: Ra'ayin Inrupt, a cewar shugaban kamfanin John Bruce, shine kamfanin ya kawo kayayyaki, tsari da kuma dabarun da suka dace don taimakawa wajen sanya Solid a samu ga kowa.
rows.reference: Ra’ayin Inrupt, a cewar Shugaban kamfanin John Bruce, shi ne kamfanin zai kawo albarkatun, tsari da kuma dacewa don taimakawa wajen samar da Solid ga kowa.
